label.purpose: Coordinates, state labels, and compact captions.

mono.purpose: Protocol names, identifiers, versions, and values.

brand.purpose: Compact product identity in structural navigation.

status.purpose: Small truthful service and workflow states.

fact.purpose: Compact high-confidence values in definition lists.

instrument-title.purpose: Machine-shaped event names heading a focused instrument.

display-compact.purpose: Mobile form of the primary editorial statement.

page-display.purpose: Page-level workspace names and primary window metrics.

section-title.purpose: Focused issue evidence headings and primary metric values.

row-title.purpose: Primary labels in dense operational rows.

payload-title.purpose: Compact headings above structured event data.

shadows.name: instrument-lift
shadows.purpose: Lift the primary working instrument above the atmospheric field.

motion.name: state-only
motion.purpose: Motion explains state; it does not decorate state.

components.name: Protocol Tag
components.description: Identifies an event type and protocol version without competing with the event name.
components.css: .ds-protocol-tag { display: inline-flex; width: fit-content; padding: 0.4rem 0.62rem; border-radius: 999px; color: var(--ultraviolet-text, #463ccf); background: var(--ultraviolet-wash, #eeedff); font: 700 0.7rem SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace; } .ds-protocol-tag:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--violet, #635bff); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Instrument Card
components.description: The focal analytical surface for a single coherent signal or investigation.
components.css: .ds-instrument { color: var(--ink, #142238); background: var(--surface, #fff); border: 1px solid #bfcbd9; border-radius: 16px; padding: 2rem; box-shadow: 0 28px 60px rgb(28 47 78 / 12%); font-family: Avenir Next, Avenir, Segoe UI, sans-serif; } .ds-instrument small { color: var(--muted, #56657a); font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-instrument h2 { font-family: SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace; } .ds-instrument:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--violet, #635bff); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Event Readout
components.description: A compact machine-readable summary of context and acceptance state.
components.css: .ds-readout { display: grid; grid-template-columns: max-content 1fr; gap: .65rem 1.25rem; margin: 0; padding: 1rem 1.15rem; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--readout-bg, #f0f4f9); color: var(--ink, #142238); font: 700 .7rem SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace; } .ds-readout dt { color: var(--muted, #56657a); } .ds-readout dd { margin: 0; } .ds-readout .ds-accepted { color: var(--good, #087f5b); }

components.name: Foundation Navigation
components.description: A low-noise structural rail pairing identity with truthful system status.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; min-height: 5rem; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--hairline, #cdd6e3); color: var(--ink, #142238); font-family: Avenir Next, Avenir, Segoe UI, sans-serif; } .ds-nav strong { letter-spacing: -.02em; } .ds-nav span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .55rem; color: #38506f; font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 650; } .ds-nav i { width: .5rem; height: .5rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--good, #087f5b); box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgb(8 127 91 / 28%); }

components.name: Signal Path
components.description: The signature directional sequence from capture to accepted storage.
components.css: .ds-path { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr); margin: 0; padding: 2.5rem 0; list-style: none; color: var(--ink, #142238); font-family: Avenir Next, Avenir, Segoe UI, sans-serif; } .ds-path::before { position: absolute; top: 3.38rem; right: 10%; left: 10%; height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--violet, #635bff), var(--cyan, #12a8c4)); content: ''; } .ds-path li { position: relative; display: grid; justify-items: center; gap: .75rem; font-size: .72rem; } .ds-path i { z-index: 1; width: 1.85rem; height: 1.85rem; border: 5px solid #fff; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--violet, #635bff); box-shadow: 0 3px 12px rgb(82 76 214 / 30%); } .ds-path li:last-child i { background: var(--cyan, #12a8c4); }

narrative.overview: Spectro should feel like a precision instrument operated in cool daylight: quiet enough for sustained analytical work, but unmistakably alive when a meaningful signal appears. The interface favors evidence, context, and readable structure over dashboard theater. The visual ratio is 90% quiet, 10% signal. Pale atmospheric space, ink typography, and hairline rules form the stable field; ultraviolet and cyan appear only where state or information flow deserves attention. Motion explains state; it does not decorate state.
keyCharacteristics: Cool daylight surfaces with dark blue-black ink.
Strong editorial hierarchy paired with compact monospaced telemetry.
Sparse signal color used to reveal state, sequence, and health.
Responsive layouts that preserve reading order before visual symmetry.

rules.name: The Ten-Percent Signal Rule
rules.body: Accent color should occupy no more than roughly one tenth of a working view; its rarity is what makes it informative.

rules.name: The Meaningful Green Rule
rules.body: Green is evidence of health or acceptance, never a generic brand accent.

rules.name: The Telemetry Boundary Rule
rules.body: Use monospaced type only when the content is machine-shaped; use the humanist face for meaning and guidance.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces earn depth through task importance or state; ordinary containers stay flat.

dos: Do pair every visible signal with available project, environment, user, session, or page context.
Do reserve high-chroma color for state, direction, selection, and health.
Do keep metadata compact, tabular, and visibly subordinate to the analytical question.
Do preserve semantic reading order when a horizontal composition stacks on mobile.
donts: Don't fill pages with interchangeable KPI cards or decorative gradients.
Don't animate without explaining causality, progress, or state change.
Don't use monospaced typography for prose or product guidance.
Don't present illustrative data as live production telemetry.
